title: Enter and save the Website Builder AI connection

provenance.kind: Genuine screen recording of operator actions in real software
provenance.operator: Demo operator using agent-operated UI tools

source.storage: Private recording retained outside the repository

edit.method: Four real source ranges joined chronologically; long idle gaps and the private credential-entry interval omitted. Normal speed, full frame, no overlays, redrawn UI, simulated typing, or added cursor.
edit.rangeConvention: Start inclusive, end exclusive; seconds from source start

privateGap.captionForFilm: Credential entered privately; the field remains masked.

actionTimingBasis: Allowlisted real action-log events only. UTC tool-call times mapped to the recording start and selected ranges, rounded to milliseconds. They are tool-call times, not exact visual-event timestamps or a generated cursor trace.

observedBehavior.modelEntry: The operator types the model ID; matching suggestions appear. A later click outside the field closes suggestions. No click on a suggestion is asserted.
observedBehavior.save: Save is clicked and the Website Builder AI card appears.
observedBehavior.typing: Actual captured UI entry, which may appear at once because the UI was operated by a type tool. No slower character animation was created.

recoveryContext.initialTest: After this save, the original connection test failed with HTTP 401. The failure remains in the existing evidence; this setup clip does not claim the initial connection worked.
recoveryContext.successfulRetry: A later private credential repair and successful live test are recorded separately.

privacyReview.method: 35 one-second output samples, eleven full-resolution source frames, action-log allowlist matching, and an all-frame decoded scene-change scan (700 frames, threshold 0.025).
observations: Selected ranges do not intersect the excluded private credential interval.
No terminal, password value, API-key value, or private filesystem path observed.
Before the private gap the API-key field is empty. After it, the application displays only password bullets.
No cursor is embedded in reviewed frames; no cursor was added during editing.
privacyReview.limitations: Visual sampling with an all-frame scene-change scan and action-log verification; not OCR or a frame-by-frame credential audit. Raw video and the full action log remain private.
privacyReview.publicScope: Only this 35-second output asset and this sanitized manifest are approved for public use.
